notation: Contexts are where a component may be placed. A container tag establishes its context. allowedIn edges name supported contexts; they do not pass density or size down (only the size attribute does that).

page.summary: Top level: region padding plus a centered 72rem max width (area family: square).

region.summary: A major area of a page (8u padding, square) (area family: square).

panel.summary: A side or tool panel (6u padding, square) (area family: square).

card.summary: A self-contained surface (container family): padding xs 2u, sm 3u, md 4u (default), lg 5u, xl 6u; radius equals the padding. A card may hold a smaller card.

collection.summary: A list or set of like items (wrapper family, 2u padding): tables, data lists.

group.summary: Closely related controls (wrapper family, 1u padding): toolbars, button and chip sets.

field-grid.summary: Rows of inline fields sharing label | control | readout columns (an inspector or property panel).

radio-group.summary: Inside a ui-radio-group: radios whose value, name, disabled and read-only the group owns.

checkbox-group.summary: Inside a ui-checkbox-group: checkboxes whose checked state, name and disabled the group's value array owns.

fieldset.summary: Inside a ui-fieldset: fields of one named set, disabled together; stacked with the collection gap.

form.summary: Inside a <form>: form-associated components submit, reset and validate with it.

inline.summary: Running text or any flow content.

accordion.summary: Inside a ui-accordion: ui-collapsible children are its items (one or several open, focus moves between their triggers).

dialog.summary: Inside a dialog popup (card-xl: 6u padding, radius = padding): a title, a description, content (fields, text, a nested dialog) and an actions row of buttons.

nesting.rule: Areas hold containers, containers hold wrappers; a level may be skipped and a card may hold a smaller card (padding xs…xl). Radius by family: area square, container = its padding, wrapper concentric with its children (3u + padding).

forbidden.rule: No interactive control inside ui-button, ui-chip or ui-option.
forbidden.reason: Nested interactive content has no accessible name or focus model; the chip remove icon is a click target, not a control.

forbidden.rule: No native form elements inside any ui-* component.
forbidden.reason: Form participation goes through UIFormElement; tests enforce it.

forbidden.rule: ui-option only as a direct child of ui-listbox, ui-segmented or ui-select.
forbidden.reason: The owning list sets role, id and selection state.

forbidden.rule: ui-swatch selection only inside ui-palette with name or selectable.
forbidden.reason: The palette owns the listbox role and value.
